title: Abhang - Teerth Vithal
description: Legendary Kirana gharana rendition of Sant Namdev's poetry, celebrated across Pune and Maharashtra in the 1960s.
emotional_resonance_reason: Directly linked to morning radio listening and Ganesh festival celebrations in Pune.

title: Ghanashyam Sundara Shridhara
description: Timeless morning devotional song from the classic Marathi film Amar Bhoopali (1951), broadcast daily on All India Radio Pune.
emotional_resonance_reason: Evokes morning tea routines and school-day dawn hours for Marathi households.

title: Ketakichya Banaat
description: Melodious Geet Ramayan classic composed and sung by Sudhir Phadke, resonant across community theatre in Pune.
emotional_resonance_reason: Sudhir Phadke's signature melodic phrasings evoke memories of Balgandharva Ranga Mandir performances.

title: So What
description: Opening track of Kind of Blue featuring John Coltrane and Bill Evans; quintessential sound of early 1960s urban jazz lounges.
emotional_resonance_reason: Iconic acoustic walking bassline and muted trumpet trigger deep nostalgia without auditory overstimulation.

title: A Change Is Gonna Come
description: Civil rights era orchestral soul anthem that captured the hopeful spirit of Chicago's mid-60s neighborhoods.
emotional_resonance_reason: Rich string arrangements and Sam Cooke's warm vocal delivery offer deep emotional grounding.

title: My Favorite Things
description: Soprano saxophone jazz reimagining of Rodgers & Hammerstein's musical classic, beloved across midwestern jazz radio.
emotional_resonance_reason: Bridges familiar Broadway songbook familiarity with soothing, rhythmic jazz phrasing.
